entries.text: 我可以告诉你：Set-赛特、Master-主教、Water-水、Watershed-水处理室、Hall-亡者大厅、Necropolis-大墓地城、Chip-芯片。
entries.source_text: 我可以告诉你：Set-赛特、Master-主教、Water-水、Watershed-水处理室、Hall-亡者大厅、Necropolis-大墓地城、Chip-芯片。

entries.text: You see the ghoul leader.
entries.source_text: You see the ghoul leader.

entries.text: 你看见一个僵尸头目。
entries.source_text: 你看见一个僵尸头目。

entries.text: Thank you for not shooting first. Can I help you with anything?
entries.source_text: Thank you for not shooting first. Can I help you with anything?

entries.text: 谢谢你没直接一枪打过来，我有什么可以效劳的？
entries.source_text: 谢谢你没直接一枪打过来，我有什么可以效劳的？

entries.text: Yes, I'm looking for water.
entries.source_text: Yes, I'm looking for water.

entries.text: 有，我在找水。
entries.source_text: 有，我在找水。

entries.text: Sure, who are you?
entries.source_text: Sure, who are you?

entries.text: 当然。你是谁？
entries.source_text: 当然。你是谁？

entries.text: Nah.
entries.source_text: Nah.

entries.text: 不。
entries.source_text: 不。

entries.text: Ahh, if you like you may rest here, we will not harm you.
entries.source_text: Ahh, if you like you may rest here, we will not harm you.

entries.text: 啊，你如果需要的话，可以在这里休息，我们不会伤害你的。
entries.source_text: 啊，你如果需要的话，可以在这里休息，我们不会伤害你的。

entries.text: Ahh.
entries.source_text: Ahh.

entries.text: 啊。
entries.source_text: 啊。

entries.text: I am the leader of a simple people who have left the surface# because of the others.
entries.source_text:
I am the leader of a simple people who have left the surface
# because of the others.

entries.text: 我是一群被迫转到地下生活的人的领袖。
entries.source_text: 我是一群被迫转到地下生活的人的领袖。

entries.text: Who has forced you down here?
entries.source_text: Who has forced you down here?

entries.text: 谁把你们赶下来的？
entries.source_text: 谁把你们赶下来的？

entries.text: Geez, that's pretty dumb.
entries.source_text: Geez, that's pretty dumb.

entries.text: 日，这太衰了。
entries.source_text: 日，这太衰了。

entries.text: Hmm. Ok. Bye.
entries.source_text: Hmm. Ok. Bye.

entries.text: 嗯，好，再见。
entries.source_text: 嗯，好，再见。

entries.text: The surface of Necropolis and the water is controlled# by Set and his Ghouls. We are a much more peaceful group - which# disgusts Set.
entries.source_text:
The surface of Necropolis and the water is controlled
# by Set and his Ghouls. We are a much more peaceful group - which
# disgusts Set.

entries.text: 大墓地的地表和水源都被赛特和他的手下控制了，我们是相比而言更爱好和平的一群，这就激怒了赛特。
entries.source_text: 大墓地的地表和水源都被赛特和他的手下控制了，我们是相比而言更爱好和平的一群，这就激怒了赛特。

entries.text: Who is this Set?
entries.source_text: Who is this Set?

entries.text: 谁是赛特？
entries.source_text: 谁是赛特？

entries.text: Well, I've taken care of Set. He won't bother you further.
entries.source_text: Well, I've taken care of Set. He won't bother you further.

entries.text: 我那赛特那厮处理了，他不会再麻烦你们了。
entries.source_text: 我那赛特那厮处理了，他不会再麻烦你们了。

entries.text: How then do you survive down here without water?
entries.source_text: How then do you survive down here without water?

entries.text: 那你们没了水怎么在这里活下去的？
entries.source_text: 那你们没了水怎么在这里活下去的？

entries.text: Well I sure wouldn't like a bunch of pansies either, Set# sounds like an OK guy.
entries.source_text:
Well I sure wouldn't like a bunch of pansies either, Set
# sounds like an OK guy.

entries.text: 我本人也不喜欢娘娘腔的和平分子，赛特至少还算是个爷们。
entries.source_text: 我本人也不喜欢娘娘腔的和平分子，赛特至少还算是个爷们。

entries.text: Set is a Ghoul like us, but has assumed a certain amount of# power in the above ground world. He is an oaf.
entries.source_text:
Set is a Ghoul like us, but has assumed a certain amount of
# power in the above ground world. He is an oaf.

entries.text: 赛特和我们一样也是一个僵尸，但在地表世界获得了一定的权力，他是个混球。
entries.source_text: 赛特和我们一样也是一个僵尸，但在地表世界获得了一定的权力，他是个混球。

entries.text: He sounds a lot more interesting than you freaks.
entries.source_text: He sounds a lot more interesting than you freaks.

entries.text: 他听起来比你们这些变态分子有趣儿多了。
entries.source_text: 他听起来比你们这些变态分子有趣儿多了。

entries.text: Why does he let you survive down here?
entries.source_text: Why does he let you survive down here?

entries.text: 他为什么还让你们在这里活下来了？
entries.source_text: 他为什么还让你们在这里活下来了？

entries.text: He does not speak of it, however Set is afraid of not having# enough people to defend Necropolis if it ever needed it. So, he gives# us what water we need.
entries.source_text:
He does not speak of it, however Set is afraid of not having
# enough people to defend Necropolis if it ever needed it. So, he gives
# us what water we need.

entries.text: 他也没说，可能是因为赛特怕防御大墓地城的时候人手不够吧，所以他给了我们必需的水。
entries.source_text: 他也没说，可能是因为赛特怕防御大墓地城的时候人手不够吧，所以他给了我们必需的水。

entries.text: Where does all of this water come from?
entries.source_text: Where does all of this water come from?

entries.text: 这些水都是哪里来的？
entries.source_text: 这些水都是哪里来的？

entries.text: I need water for my people! If you know where he gets it# from, tell me now!
entries.source_text:
I need water for my people! If you know where he gets it
# from, tell me now!

entries.text: 我的人民需要水！如果你知道从哪里拿的，告诉我！
entries.source_text: 我的人民需要水！如果你知道从哪里拿的，告诉我！

entries.text: I am looking for a Water Chip, to give my people the water# they need. Do you know where I might find one?
entries.source_text:
I am looking for a Water Chip, to give my people the water
# they need. Do you know where I might find one?

entries.text: 我在找净水芯片，为我的人民提供水源，你知道哪里有这个东西么？
entries.source_text: 我在找净水芯片，为我的人民提供水源，你知道哪里有这个东西么？

entries.text: I wouldn't keep you guys around to defend a paper bag. So# what's this about water?
entries.source_text:
I wouldn't keep you guys around to defend a paper bag. So
# what's this about water?

entries.text: 我要是他才不会让你们这些人保护这个破地方，谈谈水的事情吧。
entries.source_text: 我要是他才不会让你们这些人保护这个破地方，谈谈水的事情吧。

entries.text: Up until recently we pumped our water from the ground, with# a pump in the Watershed.
entries.source_text:
Up until recently we pumped our water from the ground, with
# a pump in the Watershed.

entries.text: 知道不久前，我们还是从地表的水口用水泵抽水。
entries.source_text: 知道不久前，我们还是从地表的水口用水泵抽水。

entries.text: Until recently? What has happened that changed things?
entries.source_text: Until recently? What has happened that changed things?

entries.text: 不久前之后呢？
entries.source_text: 不久前之后呢？

entries.text: How do I get to the Watershed?
entries.source_text: How do I get to the Watershed?

entries.text: 我怎么去水泵那里？
entries.source_text: 我怎么去水泵那里？

entries.text: What is the Watershed?
entries.source_text: What is the Watershed?

entries.text: 什么是水口？
entries.source_text: 什么是水口？

entries.text: Since our pump stopped working, we have been getting our water# from a place under the ground. I have heard that a water computer# is being used to purify the water.
entries.source_text:
Since our pump stopped working, we have been getting our water
# from a place under the ground. I have heard that a water computer
# is being used to purify the water.

entries.text: 我们的水泵坏了，所以我们现在是从地下的某个地方取水，我听说那里有台净水控制电脑。
entries.source_text: 我们的水泵坏了，所以我们现在是从地下的某个地方取水，我听说那里有台净水控制电脑。

entries.text: Thanks.
entries.source_text: Thanks.

entries.text: 谢谢。
entries.source_text: 谢谢。

entries.text: Where is that?
entries.source_text: Where is that?

entries.text: 那在哪里？
entries.source_text: 那在哪里？

entries.text: The watershed is to the north. You'll need to take the sewers# to get there.
entries.source_text:
The watershed is to the north. You'll need to take the sewers
# to get there.

entries.text: 水口在北方，你可以从下水道去那里。
entries.source_text: 水口在北方，你可以从下水道去那里。

entries.text: You aren't thinking of taking the Water Chip from us are you?
entries.source_text: You aren't thinking of taking the Water Chip from us are you?

entries.text: 你不会是想把净水芯片取走吧？
entries.source_text: 你不会是想把净水芯片取走吧？

entries.text: Umm.. Me, no, I would never do such a thing. I am just going# to see how it all works.
entries.source_text:
Umm.. Me, no, I would never do such a thing. I am just going
# to see how it all works.

entries.text: 呃……不，不是的。我才不会做这种事情呢，我去看看它的工作情况。
entries.source_text: 呃……不，不是的。我才不会做这种事情呢，我去看看它的工作情况。

entries.text: Of course, my people need the Water Chip to survive.
entries.source_text: Of course, my people need the Water Chip to survive.

entries.text: 当然了，我们的人民需要净水芯片。
entries.source_text: 当然了，我们的人民需要净水芯片。

entries.text: Why?
entries.source_text: Why?

entries.text: 怎么？
entries.source_text: 怎么？

entries.text: If you take the Water Chip from us, then we will all die. With# our water pump broken we need it to survive.
entries.source_text:
If you take the Water Chip from us, then we will all die. With
# our water pump broken we need it to survive.

entries.text: 如果你把芯片拿走，我们都会死的，我们的水泵坏了，我们没有水了。
entries.source_text: 如果你把芯片拿走，我们都会死的，我们的水泵坏了，我们没有水了。

entries.text: Well, I really don't care about you and your people. We need# the water chip for our own survival. Goodbye.
entries.source_text:
Well, I really don't care about you and your people. We need
# the water chip for our own survival. Goodbye.

entries.text: 我才不管你们的死活，我们也要芯片才能生存下去，再见！
entries.source_text: 我才不管你们的死活，我们也要芯片才能生存下去，再见！

entries.text: Is it possible that your pump could be fixed?
entries.source_text: Is it possible that your pump could be fixed?

entries.text: 也许你们的水泵能修好？
entries.source_text: 也许你们的水泵能修好？

entries.text: If that is the case then I can't let you leave my presence alive.
entries.source_text: If that is the case then I can't let you leave my presence alive.

entries.text: 如果这样，我不能让你走！
entries.source_text: 如果这样，我不能让你走！

entries.text: I do not think that I believe you.
entries.source_text: I do not think that I believe you.

entries.text: 我不相信你。
entries.source_text: 我不相信你。

entries.text: I am sorry I did not mean to deceive you. What is wrong with# taking the Water Chip.
entries.source_text:
I am sorry I did not mean to deceive you. What is wrong with
# taking the Water Chip.

entries.text: 对不起，我不是想骗你的。如果我拿走了芯片，会怎么样？
entries.source_text: 对不起，我不是想骗你的。如果我拿走了芯片，会怎么样？

entries.text: Well I don't really care. If you won't get out of my way, I'll# just remove you myself.
entries.source_text:
Well I don't really care. If you won't get out of my way, I'll
# just remove you myself.

entries.text: 我不在乎，如果你再挡道，我就会让你消失！
entries.source_text: 我不在乎，如果你再挡道，我就会让你消失！

entries.text: That may be difficult. The parts needed to fix the pump were lost# in the sewers under the watershed.
entries.source_text:
That may be difficult. The parts needed to fix the pump were lost
# in the sewers under the watershed.

entries.text: 这很难的，修理水泵的那部分零件丢在水口下的下水道了。
entries.source_text: 这很难的，修理水泵的那部分零件丢在水口下的下水道了。

entries.text: Why is that so difficult?
entries.source_text: Why is that so difficult?

entries.text: 这有什么难的？
entries.source_text: 这有什么难的？

entries.text: Do you mean these parts? (You show the parts you found to the# Ghoul Leader)
entries.source_text:
Do you mean these parts? (You show the parts you found to the
# Ghoul Leader)

entries.text: 你是说这些零件么？【你把捡到的零件给他看】
entries.source_text: 你是说这些零件么？【你把捡到的零件给他看】

entries.text: The sewers there are filled with monsters, and none of my people# that I have sent to retrieve them have come back. Are you willing to# retrieve the parts, so that the Water Pump can be fixed?
entries.source_text:
The sewers there are filled with monsters, and none of my people
# that I have sent to retrieve them have come back. Are you willing to
# retrieve the parts, so that the Water Pump can be fixed?

entries.text: 下水道里都是怪物，我派去找零件的人都没回来。你愿意去帮我们拿来再修好水泵吗？
entries.source_text: 下水道里都是怪物，我派去找零件的人都没回来。你愿意去帮我们拿来再修好水泵吗？

entries.text: Sounds like too much trouble, I think I'll just take the Water# Chip.
entries.source_text:
Sounds like too much trouble, I think I'll just take the Water
# Chip.

entries.text: 太烦人了，我还是直接拿走芯片方便。
entries.source_text: 太烦人了，我还是直接拿走芯片方便。

entries.text: Yes.
entries.source_text: Yes.

entries.text: 好的。
entries.source_text: 好的。

entries.text: Since you guys are to incompetent to do this yourself, I guess# I'll have to lend a hand.
entries.source_text:
Since you guys are to incompetent to do this yourself, I guess
# I'll have to lend a hand.

entries.text: 你们既然这般无能，我就帮你们一把吧。
entries.source_text: 你们既然这般无能，我就帮你们一把吧。

entries.text: Thank you. When you get the parts, return here. It is possible# that I can help you further.
entries.source_text:
Thank you. When you get the parts, return here. It is possible
# that I can help you further.

entries.text: 谢谢。拿到零件后，回来，也许我能帮上点忙。
entries.source_text: 谢谢。拿到零件后，回来，也许我能帮上点忙。

entries.text: Ok, I'll be on my way then.
entries.source_text: Ok, I'll be on my way then.

entries.text: 好，我去了。
entries.source_text: 好，我去了。

entries.text: Have you found the parts for the Water Pump yet?
entries.source_text: Have you found the parts for the Water Pump yet?

entries.text: 你找到水泵零件了？
entries.source_text: 你找到水泵零件了？

entries.text: Not yet.
entries.source_text: Not yet.

entries.text: 还没。
entries.source_text: 还没。

entries.text: Nope. And I've decided to forget the whole thing.
entries.source_text: Nope. And I've decided to forget the whole thing.

entries.text: 算了，我不费这个事了。
entries.source_text: 算了，我不费这个事了。

entries.text: Where was I supposed to find them again?
entries.source_text: Where was I supposed to find them again?

entries.text: 我要去哪里找，你再说一遍。
entries.source_text: 我要去哪里找，你再说一遍。

entries.text: Well I wish you luck then.
entries.source_text: Well I wish you luck then.

entries.text: 那好，我祝你好运。
entries.source_text: 那好，我祝你好运。

entries.text: You have returned. Do you have the parts needed to repair the# Water Pump?
entries.source_text:
You have returned. Do you have the parts needed to repair the
# Water Pump?

entries.text: 你回来了，找到修水泵的零件了？
entries.source_text: 你回来了，找到修水泵的零件了？

entries.text: Yes, here they are.
entries.source_text: Yes, here they are.

entries.text: 对，这里。
entries.source_text: 对，这里。

entries.text: Yeah, but I've decided to forget about fixing the Water Pump.
entries.source_text: Yeah, but I've decided to forget about fixing the Water Pump.

entries.text: 没错，但是我不打算去修那个什么水泵了。
entries.source_text: 没错，但是我不打算去修那个什么水泵了。

entries.text: Well it looks like you may need some help with the parts. Here# are some books that we have found littered around. They may help you.# Now please take the parts to the water shed and repair the pump.
entries.source_text:
Well it looks like you may need some help with the parts. Here
# are some books that we have found littered around. They may help you.
# Now please take the parts to the water shed and repair the pump.

entries.text: 你用这些零件去修理，我可以帮你的。这是我们在附近找到的几本书，也许有用，带上零件去修好它吧。
entries.source_text: 你用这些零件去修理，我可以帮你的。这是我们在附近找到的几本书，也许有用，带上零件去修好它吧。

entries.text: Unfortunately I will be able to help you no further. Good luck# with the Water Pump. Please take the parts to the water shed and# repair the pump.
entries.source_text:
Unfortunately I will be able to help you no further. Good luck
# with the Water Pump. Please take the parts to the water shed and
# repair the pump.

entries.text: 我不能再帮你什么了，祝你修理顺利。带上零件去修好它吧。
entries.source_text: 我不能再帮你什么了，祝你修理顺利。带上零件去修好它吧。

entries.text: Have you fixed the Water Pump yet?
entries.source_text: Have you fixed the Water Pump yet?

entries.text: 你修好水泵了？
entries.source_text: 你修好水泵了？

entries.text: No not yet, but I am still working on it.
entries.source_text: No not yet, but I am still working on it.

entries.text: 还没，我在努力。
entries.source_text: 还没，我在努力。

entries.text: No, and I am not planning on it now.
entries.source_text: No, and I am not planning on it now.

entries.text: 还没，我不干了。
entries.source_text: 还没，我不干了。

entries.text: Yes those are the parts I was talking about. Thank the flow# that you already have them.
entries.source_text:
Yes those are the parts I was talking about. Thank the flow
# that you already have them.

entries.text: 没错，这就是我说的那些零件。你先找到了，真是太好了。
entries.source_text: 没错，这就是我说的那些零件。你先找到了，真是太好了。

entries.text: Is there anything else I should know?
entries.source_text: Is there anything else I should know?

entries.text: 我还需要知道些什么？
entries.source_text: 我还需要知道些什么？

entries.text: Well that's as close as they are going to get to the Water Pump.
entries.source_text: Well that's as close as they are going to get to the Water Pump.

entries.text: 就在水泵旁边。
entries.source_text: 就在水泵旁边。

entries.text: As I already told you, they can be found in the sewers underneath# the Water shed. Go east from here, and then north. You will find the# Watershed in that direction.
entries.source_text:
As I already told you, they can be found in the sewers underneath
# the Water shed. Go east from here, and then north. You will find the
# Watershed in that direction.

entries.text: 我说过了，就在水口下方的下水道里，从这里往东，再往北走，你就可以看见水口了。
entries.source_text: 我说过了，就在水口下方的下水道里，从这里往东，再往北走，你就可以看见水口了。

entries.text: Thanks for the directions. Goodbye.
entries.source_text: Thanks for the directions. Goodbye.

entries.text: 谢谢你的指点，再见。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你的指点，再见。

entries.text: Well thank you for that service. Was there something else you# wanted to know?
entries.source_text:
Well thank you for that service. Was there something else you
# wanted to know?

entries.text: 谢谢你能帮忙，你还要知道什么？
entries.source_text: 谢谢你能帮忙，你还要知道什么？

entries.text: How do you survive down here without water?
entries.source_text: How do you survive down here without water?

entries.text: 你们在这里没水怎么活下去的？
entries.source_text: 你们在这里没水怎么活下去的？

entries.text: It is where all the water is stored and handed out to us.
entries.source_text: It is where all the water is stored and handed out to us.

entries.text: 那里就是我们储水和分发水的地方。
entries.source_text: 那里就是我们储水和分发水的地方。

entries.text: Where is it located?
entries.source_text: Where is it located?

entries.text: 具体位置？
entries.source_text: 具体位置？

entries.text: Lately I have heard rumors that someone has taken over the# control of the Watershed. However, our rations are still being# delivered for some reason.
entries.source_text:
Lately I have heard rumors that someone has taken over the
# control of the Watershed. However, our rations are still being
# delivered for some reason.

entries.text: 最近我听说有人控制了水口，但是，我们的份额没减少。不知道为什么。
entries.source_text: 最近我听说有人控制了水口，但是，我们的份额没减少。不知道为什么。

entries.text: How do I get to the Watershed?
entries.source_text: How do I get to the Watershed?

entries.text: 我怎么去水口？
entries.source_text: 我怎么去水口？

entries.text: What is the Watershed?
entries.source_text: What is the Watershed?

entries.text: 什么是水口？
entries.source_text: 什么是水口？

entries.text: Thank you for repairing the Water Pump, and I hope all is# well with your people when you return with what you have found.
entries.source_text:
Thank you for repairing the Water Pump, and I hope all is
# well with your people when you return with what you have found.

entries.text: 谢谢你修好了水泵，我希望你带着芯片回去之后能帮助你的人民度过难关。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你修好了水泵，我希望你带着芯片回去之后能帮助你的人民度过难关。

entries.text: Thank you for your help. Goodbye.
entries.source_text: Thank you for your help. Goodbye.

entries.text: 多谢，再见。
entries.source_text: 多谢，再见。

entries.text: You have fixed the Water Pump and the flow has returned from# the deep. However, I see you have not found what you are looking for.
entries.source_text:
You have fixed the Water Pump and the flow has returned from
# the deep. However, I see you have not found what you are looking for.

entries.text: 你修好了水泵，水再次流出来了，但是，你还没有找到你需要的东西。
entries.source_text: 你修好了水泵，水再次流出来了，但是，你还没有找到你需要的东西。

entries.text: Yes, I cannot seem to find the location of the Water Chip.
entries.source_text: Yes, I cannot seem to find the location of the Water Chip.

entries.text: 是的，我找不到净水芯片。
entries.source_text: 是的，我找不到净水芯片。

entries.text: I have heard that it is located deeply below the Watershed.# I wish you luck in searching for it.
entries.source_text:
I have heard that it is located deeply below the Watershed.
# I wish you luck in searching for it.

entries.text: 我听说它可以在水口地下很深的地方找到。我预祝你成功。
entries.source_text: 我听说它可以在水口地下很深的地方找到。我预祝你成功。

entries.text: I see that you have what you came here to find. You realize# that we will die if you take the Water Chip from us.
entries.source_text:
I see that you have what you came here to find. You realize
# that we will die if you take the Water Chip from us.

entries.text: 我看到你找到了你要的东西，你要知道，如果拿走了芯片，我们都会死的。
entries.source_text: 我看到你找到了你要的东西，你要知道，如果拿走了芯片，我们都会死的。

entries.text: Yes, but I am still working to fix the Water Pump. Where did# you say I could find the parts?
entries.source_text:
Yes, but I am still working to fix the Water Pump. Where did
# you say I could find the parts?

entries.text: 是，但是我正在修理水泵，你上次说在哪里找到零件来着？
entries.source_text: 是，但是我正在修理水泵，你上次说在哪里找到零件来着？

entries.text: I need the Water Chip and I don't have time to deal with your# problems.
entries.source_text:
I need the Water Chip and I don't have time to deal with your
# problems.

entries.text: 我需要芯片，我没时间管你们的破事。
entries.source_text: 我需要芯片，我没时间管你们的破事。

entries.text: What other options do I have.
entries.source_text: What other options do I have.

entries.text: 我没有其他办法了。
entries.source_text: 我没有其他办法了。

entries.text: I am tired of putting up with your snide remarks. I do not# wish to speak with you any further.
entries.source_text:
I am tired of putting up with your snide remarks. I do not
# wish to speak with you any further.

entries.text: 我受够了你的虚伪说辞了，我不想再和你多嘴了。
entries.source_text: 我受够了你的虚伪说辞了，我不想再和你多嘴了。

entries.text: We once had a pump located in the Watershed that pumped the# flow from the deep. However, it was broken and the parts needed to# fix it were lost in the sewers directly below the Watershed.
entries.source_text:
We once had a pump located in the Watershed that pumped the
# flow from the deep. However, it was broken and the parts needed to
# fix it were lost in the sewers directly below the Watershed.

entries.text: 我们以前在水口有一台水泵可以抽水，但是现在它坏了，修理的零件就在水口地下的下水道里。

entries.text: Why have you not retrieved the parts yourself?
entries.source_text: Why have you not retrieved the parts yourself?

entries.text: 你们为什么自己不去拿零件？
entries.source_text: 你们为什么自己不去拿零件？

entries.text: You have nothing to fear from us!
entries.source_text: You have nothing to fear from us!

entries.text: 你不需要怕我们！
entries.source_text: 你不需要怕我们！

entries.text: I will speak with you before you leave.
entries.source_text: I will speak with you before you leave.

entries.text: 在你离开前，我有话要和你说。
entries.source_text: 在你离开前，我有话要和你说。

entries.text: You have left me no choice, but to stop you myself.
entries.source_text: You have left me no choice, but to stop you myself.

entries.text: 运气不好。
entries.source_text: 运气不好。

entries.text: Can't the water pump be repaired?
entries.source_text: Can't the water pump be repaired?

entries.text: 水泵不能修好吗？
entries.source_text: 水泵不能修好吗？

entries.text: I'm sorry but my people need the chip to survive.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry but my people need the chip to survive.

entries.text: 对不起，我们的人民需要芯片才能生存。
entries.source_text: 对不起，我们的人民需要芯片才能生存。

entries.text: Please don't take our chip. Without it we will die.
entries.source_text: Please don't take our chip. Without it we will die.

entries.text: 别拿走我们的芯片，我们会死的。
entries.source_text: 别拿走我们的芯片，我们会死的。

entries.text: Maybe, but the parts are lost in the sewers beneath the watershed.# With all those monsters there, we can't get them back.
